_doc: slide-builder skill settings. Read by build_deck.py at startup. Per-build CLI flags override these. Edit + save; takes effect on next invocation. The two build paths are documented in _decisions/pattern-b/README.md.
_doc_default_pattern: One of: legacy | auto | sketch | direct. 'legacy' = pptx-direct-only pipeline verbatim (the safe fallback). 'auto' = per-slide routing via _classify_all_slides. 'sketch' = force all slides through the HTML-first path. 'direct' = force all slides through the pptx-direct path (native, no HTML stage). Per-build override: build_deck.py --pattern <value>.
_doc_options_per_slide_revision: Options built when a slide is rebuilt after the user's feedback (build_deck.py --slide N, also what REVIEW.html's Replace these runs). The user has already said what to change, so one focused option is enough and about three times faster than three. A full build and a newly inserted slide still use options_per_slide. build_deck.py --options N overrides either.
_doc_options_per_slide: How many design options each slide's worker produces up front (1-3). Ships at 3 so every slide has alternatives to compare. Cost: three options run roughly 1.3-1.5x the tokens of one, because the worker's setup is shared and only the picked option is converted to PowerPoint (unmeasured estimate). Set to 1 to minimize tokens. Read via _paths.option_letters(). NOTE: a single option is still NOT an auto-pick. REVIEW.html remains a human gate: the user picks every slide (recorded by record_picks.py), then looks at the finished picks in FINAL-CHECK.html, whose Build command carries the --final-token compile requires.
_doc_translator: How picked sketch designs become native PowerPoint. 'script' = scripts/translate_html.py (deterministic, seconds per slide; it renders its own result and hands any element it cannot draw, or that came out looking different, to the agent in fallback mode). 'agent' = the slide-builder-translator agent translates every picked option. 'script' since 2026-10-01: on 272 past options it kept 99%+ of line breaks, opened in PowerPoint, and a blind comparison of 40 slides found it closer to the design than the agent 27 to 5. Re-run tests/translate_gonogo.py before changing the translator.
_doc_enable_sketch: Master switch for the sketch (HTML-first) path. When false, default_pattern is forced to 'legacy' regardless of its value, and --pattern auto|sketch is downgraded.
_doc_html_render_canvas: Locked. Do not change without re-validating geometry across all locked specs.
_doc_ssim_thresholds: NOT ENFORCED by any script today. Intended: Critical < 0.70 halts, Major < 0.85 surfaces in REVIEW.html. In practice translator similarity scores are font-rendering noise on most slides (112 of 151 real ones scored under 0.90, and the real defects were caught by looking), so they are informational only.
_doc_translator_timeout_seconds: NOT ENFORCED by any script today: translator agents are dispatched by the chat session, which has no per-agent timeout. Kept for when translation moves to a script.
